board.ts.description: Reading an agent's board/1 (ok-board, board-1114/06 §7.3–§7.4). Pure; the page only reads, never writes for an agent.

cmdHistory.ts.description: Command history and pins use injected key-value storage and bounded, deduplicated lists.

commands.test.ts.description: Command tests cover parsing, aliases, backend-only availability, safety rules, history, and pins.

commands.ts.description: Slash commands combine page actions with the backend-owned CLI command list.

drafts.ts.description: Drafts (12.8 #5): one per target, every field kept, so switching say / mail / order never loses text.

inbox.ts.description: The to-do queue (02c §2): four kinds in a fixed order, all derived from data the page already has (no model).

keyHelp.test.ts.description: The help reference must keep all eight areas and nonempty shortcut descriptions.

keyHelp.ts.description: The shortcut reference lists only controls currently available on the page.

layoutMap.ts.description: The map's layout (P4; 02e §3, q5 a), pure so node --test can check it: "wide rooms, people before rooms".

lights.test.ts.description: Light tests distinguish own status, descendants, whole rooms, and missing rollup counts.

lights.ts.description: Separate a node's own light from the warning counts below it or inside a room.

mapOpts.test.ts.description: Map option tests verify safe parsing, plate sizes, and layout propagation.

mapOpts.ts.description: Map display options parse persisted values and determine plate dimensions.

model.test.ts.description: Pure model tests: board, inbox, route, tree rows, palette and map layout (node --test).

multi.test.ts.description: Selection tests cover toggles, both range directions, rectangle overlap, and normalization.

multi.ts.description: Pure selection helpers toggle agents, select ordered ranges, and hit-test map rectangles.

palette.ts.description: Ctrl+K: find someone, or say what to do first (02d §4.2 "找人框兼做下命令"). Pure, so node --test checks it.

time.ts.description: Time words (pure). The page counts "N min ago" itself from epoch fields, on the 10 s local tick (12.8 #7).

tree.ts.description: Tree helpers (pure). A department = a node with members (children). The company = the roots that are agents,

wallDetail.test.ts.description: Wall detail tests cover parsing, stepping, cycling, overrides, machine limits, and stale ids.

wallDetail.ts.description: Pure wall-card detail settings support per-node overrides and whole-wall defaults.

words.ts.description: The back end's light reasons ("why") are English (program output stays English, conventions); the page shows them
